summary.en: CAR soldiers and officers have completed a Rwanda special forces and basic special operations force training, expanding their capabilities. Navy marines and other troops have neutralised 34 Boko Haram and ISWAP fighters in Lake Chad, intensifying security actions near the CAR border. Russia and the Central African Republic renewed bilateral relations in October 2026, indicating continued foreign engagement. A water dispute in central Chad sparked inter-communal fighting that left dozens dead. The conflict recorded 246 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
